Black Friday skincare: what to stock up on and what to skip Not everything on sale is worth buying extra of. Before you check out, sort your cart into restocks and experiments. Restocks are worth stocking up on. With experiments, get one or hold off. - Buy extra: your everyday cleanser, moisturizer and sunscreen - Buy extra if you already use them: adapalene, niacinamide, azelaic acid - Just one bottle: vitamin C and retinol, since they lose strength faster - One at a time: new actives, so you can tell what caused a reaction - Sunscreen with no date on it: replace it 3 years after buying Save this for your Black Friday shopping.
